name: Royale Masala Agarbatti
description:
A premium blend of natural herbs, resins, and floral extracts crafted into rich masala incense sticks using traditional Indian techniques.
The warm, earthy fragrance creates a divine atmosphere perfect for daily puja rituals and meditation sessions.
Each stick burns evenly for approximately 30 minutes, filling the room with a long-lasting, soothing aroma that lingers well after the burn.
Made by Invita Company using time-honoured masala methods passed down through generations of master craftsmen.
Ideal for morning aarti, yoga practice, or simply elevating the ambiance of your sacred space.

name: Bambooless Sandal Agarbatti
description:
Experience the pure, undiluted essence of sandalwood in these handcrafted bambooless incense sticks, free from synthetic cores.
Without a bamboo stick, these agarbattis release a cleaner, more authentic sandalwood fragrance from the very first burn to the last.
The calming sandalwood aroma is revered for its grounding and stress-relieving properties in Ayurvedic tradition.
Each stick burns completely without leaving any residue, making them ideal for enclosed puja rooms and home shrines.
A perfect, pure offering to deities — the preferred choice of temples across South India.

name: Long Garden Rose Agarbatti
description:
These extra-long 16-inch rose agarbattis fill large prayer halls and meditation spaces with the intoxicating fragrance of fresh garden roses.
Crafted with real rose extracts and natural binding agents, they create a romantic and spiritually uplifting ambiance that soothes the mind.
The extended burn time makes them perfectly suited for prolonged rituals, bhajans, and ceremonial gatherings.
Each stick releases a consistent, true-to-nature rose fragrance with no harsh chemical afterburn.
A timeless classic for Lakshmi puja, Navratri celebrations, and other floral deity offerings.

name: Citronella Mosquito Repellent Agarbatti
description:
A dual-purpose incense that combines the natural repellent properties of pure citronella oil with a refreshing, uplifting fragrance.
Ideal for outdoor pujas, garden prayer areas, and evening aarti where mosquitoes are a concern during worship.
Made with genuine citronella extract and natural herbs, they are safe for use around children when used in well-ventilated spaces.
The light, lemony aroma is cleansing and invigorating, adding a cheerful note to morning and evening prayer routines.
A practical, eco-friendly addition to every home, balcony altar, and outdoor temple.

name: Flora Jasmine Agarbatti
description:
Capture the sweet, heady fragrance of jasmine blooms in every stick of this beloved agarbatti, a staple in Indian devotional practice.
Jasmine has been used in Hindu and Buddhist traditions for centuries as an offering to deities and a purifier of the mind and spirit.
Each 100 g pack ensures a long-lasting, consistent fragrance that faithfully replicates fresh jasmine, even out of season.
The smooth-burning formula produces minimal smoke while maximising fragrance throw throughout the room.
A perennial favourite for Ganesh puja, Navratri, and daily worship at home temples.

name: Premium Oudh Agarbatti Pouch
description:
Experience the rare and luxurious fragrance of oud wood in this premium agarbatti collection, sourced from select agarwood resins.
The deep, complex, and mesmerising aroma of oud carries centuries of tradition from the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
The convenient resealable pouch packaging keeps the sticks fresh, preserving the precious oud fragrance between uses.
Each stick burns for approximately 45 minutes, making them perfect for extended meditations and special festive ceremonies.
A symbol of luxury and spiritual elevation — the finest incense sticks in our entire collection.

name: Chandan Wet Dhoop
description:
Traditional wet sandalwood dhoop sticks made using an age-old recipe of pure chandan paste, Ayurvedic herbs, and natural binding agents.
Unlike dry incense, wet dhoop produces a thicker, more fragrant smoke that quickly fills the entire space with a rich, earthy sandalwood aroma.
Specially crafted for use in hawan, aarti, and deep ceremonial rituals that demand a powerful, authentic fragrance.
The 20-stick pack provides ample supply for daily puja needs and festive occasions throughout the month.
Beloved across temples and traditional households for its authentic, unadulterated chandan fragrance.

name: Guggal Dhoop Sticks
description:
Pure guggal (Indian bdellium) resin dhoop sticks revered for their powerful purifying and healing properties across Indian traditions.
Used in Ayurvedic medicine and spiritual practices for thousands of years, guggal smoke is believed to cleanse negative energies from spaces.
These sticks produce a warm, balsamic, slightly sweet fragrance that creates an atmosphere of profound calm and devotion.
Each stick burns slowly and steadily, releasing the precious resin's full aromatic spectrum over an extended burn period.
Essential for griha pravesh, housewarming puja, and regular spiritual cleansing of your home or workspace.

name: Lavender Perfume Dhoop
description:
Artisanal lavender dhoop sticks crafted with premium lavender essential oil and natural resins for a calming, aromatherapeutic experience.
The gentle floral fragrance promotes relaxation, stress relief, and mental clarity, making them ideal for evening meditation and bedtime rituals.
Each stick provides a clean, smoke-light burn that is gentle on sensitive airways and suitable for smaller, enclosed rooms.
These sticks beautifully bridge traditional Indian puja culture with modern wellness and mindfulness practices.
A must-have for anyone seeking tranquillity and inner peace in their home sacred space.

name: Masala Dhoop Cones
description:
Classic masala dhoop cones made from a traditional blend of aromatic herbs, resins, and natural binders in the Indian handcraft tradition.
The cone shape concentrates the fragrance, producing a rich, intense aromatic cloud that quickly fills any room with devotional warmth.
Available in 12-cone and 36-cone packs to suit both everyday use and large-scale ceremonies or festivals.
The masala blend includes a proprietary selection of natural ingredients that burn cleanly and evenly without excessive smoke.
An essential part of any puja thali and a timeless daily offering in traditional Indian households.

name: Loban Dhoop Stick Jar
description:
A generous jar of loban (benzoin) dhoop sticks revered across South Asian and Arabian traditions for their deep, balsamic, purifying fragrance.
Loban smoke is traditionally used to ward off negative energies, cleanse sacred spaces, and attract positive vibrations into the home.
The convenient airtight jar packaging preserves freshness and allows for easy, mess-free dispensing between uses.
Each stick burns consistently, releasing loban's rich vanilla-and-spice aroma throughout the entire burning duration.
A classic staple for regular use in temples, home shrines, and all festive ritual spaces.

name: Pure Camphor Tablets
description:
Pharmaceutical-grade 99% pure camphor tablets, the cornerstone of Hindu puja rituals and Ayurvedic purification practices.
These snow-white tablets burn with a bright, clean flame and produce a characteristic sharp, purifying aroma that instantly elevates any worship space.
Camphor is believed to purify the air, ward off negative energies, and establish a direct connection between the worshipper and the divine.
Available in 100 g and 250 g packs to suit the needs of regular households and frequent ceremonial use.
The highest purity grade ensures maximum fragrance throw and complete combustion leaving no residue behind.

name: Brass Kapur Dani
description:
A beautifully crafted solid brass camphor holder (kapur dani) featuring intricate traditional Indian motifs and a generous 8 cm height.
The sturdy brass construction and perforated lid allow camphor smoke to disperse freely, ensuring an even fragrance throughout aarti.
The ergonomic design makes it comfortable to hold and wave during aarti, while the deep base safely contains the burning tablet.
Over time, the brass develops a rich golden patina that deepens its devotional character and beauty.
Compatible with standard camphor tablets and cube forms — an heirloom-quality vessel for every home puja room.

name: Sambrani Hawan Cups
description:
Traditional sambrani (benzoin resin) cups designed for easy, convenient use during hawan, purification, and home blessing rituals.
Each cup is pre-filled with high-quality sambrani resin that burns steadily when lit, releasing thick, fragrant purifying smoke.
Sambrani is prized in traditional Indian medicine for its antimicrobial properties and its role in ceremonies marking births, marriages, and festivals.
The simple cup design eliminates the need for charcoal preparation — just light the cup directly and let the sacred smoke do the rest.
The 12-cup pack provides multiple sessions of ceremonial or everyday use at exceptional value.

name: Cotton Puja Wicks
description:
Premium hand-rolled cotton wicks made from pure, unbleached cotton for a clean, bright, and steady diya flame.
Each pack contains 200 wicks of uniform size, perfectly suited for standard brass, silver, and clay diyas used in daily puja.
The fine cotton weave ensures a smoke-free, stable flame that burns without excessive soot or dripping.
These wicks are an essential daily consumable for every practising Hindu household performing morning and evening aarti.
Their pure, unprocessed composition makes them ideal for both sesame oil lamps and pure ghee diyas alike.

name: Hawan Samagri Mix
description:
A complete, traditional hawan samagri blend prepared with over 20 carefully selected herbs, resins, seeds, and aromatic substances.
This sacred mixture is prescribed in Vedic scriptures for its purifying, medicinal, and spiritually elevating properties when offered into the sacred fire.
Each 250 g pack provides sufficient material for a full hawan ceremony for four to five participants, including multiple ahutis.
The blend includes ashwagandha, shatavari, guggal, loban, and other potent Ayurvedic herbs sourced from trusted suppliers.
Essential for griha shanti puja, navgraha hawan, Diwali hawan, and all other Vedic fire ceremonies.

name: Gangajal 500 ml
description:
Pure, holy water sourced directly from the sacred Ganges River and carefully bottled in a clean, sealed 500 ml container.
Gangajal holds immense spiritual significance in Hindu tradition and is used in virtually every puja, ritual, and life-cycle ceremony.
The water is collected, filtered, and tested at source to ensure its purity, sanctity, and compliance with food-grade standards.
A few drops of gangajal are believed to purify any object, space, or individual it touches, creating a sacred, auspicious environment.
Keep it in your puja room as an essential sacred element for daily worship, abhishek, and all special ceremonies throughout the year.

name: Sandalwood Reed Diffuser
description:
A sophisticated home fragrance diffuser featuring a premium sandalwood essential oil blend with natural fibre reeds for continuous, effortless scent release.
The 100 ml bottle ensures up to 60 days of consistent fragrance, subtly and elegantly transforming your living space day and night.
Six premium fibre reeds draw the oil upward by capillary action, releasing gentle sandalwood notes in a steady, controlled manner.
Unlike incense, this diffuser requires no flame and is perfectly safe for use in offices, nurseries, and bedrooms.
A luxurious, minimal addition to living rooms, meditation spaces, and reception areas that speaks of refinement.

name: Lemongrass Aroma Oil
description:
Energising and purifying lemongrass essential oil blend specially formulated for use in ultrasonic diffusers and traditional electric oil burners.
The crisp, citrusy fragrance of lemongrass is scientifically recognised for its mood-lifting, antibacterial, and natural insect-repelling properties.
Just a few drops in your diffuser fills an entire room with a fresh, invigorating aroma that boosts focus, clarity, and energy levels.
The concentrated 15 ml bottle provides approximately 150 to 200 hours of use in a standard ultrasonic diffuser.
Safe for use around children and pets in well-ventilated spaces when used as directed — ideal for homes and offices alike.

name: Mogra Car Diffuser
description:
A compact and elegant mogra (jasmine) car fragrance diffuser designed to keep your vehicle smelling fresh and inviting throughout your commute.
The 8 ml reservoir attaches easily to air vents or hangs from the rearview mirror for consistent, even fragrance dispersal.
Mogra's sweet, romantic scent creates a calming driving environment that significantly reduces commuter stress and road fatigue.
The adjustable fragrance intensity allows personalisation for different preferences and vehicle cabin sizes.
Long-lasting and refillable, this stylish diffuser is a sophisticated alternative to conventional car air fresheners.

name: Vanilla Scented Candle
description:
A hand-poured artisan candle crafted from a premium soy-paraffin blend wax, infused with pure Madagascar vanilla essential oil.
The exceptional 30-hour burn time ensures extended enjoyment, making this 200 g candle outstanding value for its price point.
The clean-burning soy blend produces minimal soot while maximising fragrance throw, wrapping the room in a warm, enveloping vanilla cloud.
Hand-poured into an elegant frosted glass container, it makes a thoughtful and beautiful gift for any occasion.
Ideal for creating a cosy, romantic atmosphere during evenings, bath rituals, meditation sessions, or quiet dinner parties.

name: Oudh Bakhoor Bricks
description:
Authentic Arabian bakhoor bricks made with premium oud oil and natural resins using traditional Middle Eastern fragrance craftsmanship.
These eight bricks are designed to be placed on charcoal or an electric bakhoor burner, releasing thick, opulent smoke with a rich, woody-floral oud aroma.
Bakhoor has been used for centuries across the Arabian Peninsula and South Asia to fragrance homes, clothing, hair, and ceremonial spaces.
A single brick session perfumes an entire room for hours, creating a luxurious, immersive olfactory experience unlike any other.
A premium product that bridges Indian and Arabian fragrance traditions — one of the most sought-after home fragrances in the world.

name: Rose Attar
description:
A rare, alcohol-free rose attar crafted using the ancient Indian deg-bhapka distillation process, where fresh rose petals are steam-distilled into pure sandalwood oil.
This 10 ml bottle contains a deeply concentrated, exquisitely complex rose fragrance that blossoms on the skin over hours of wear.
Completely alcohol-free, it is suitable for use by children, during religious rituals, and by those with alcohol sensitivities or skin conditions.
A single drop on the wrist or neck lasts the entire day with a graceful, natural progression from bright top notes to a warm, earthy dry-down.
One of the finest natural perfumes in the world, now accessible for everyday wear and special devotional occasions alike.

name: Lotus Backflow Incense Burner
description:
An exquisite hand-painted ceramic lotus-design backflow incense burner that creates the mesmerising visual effect of smoke cascading downward like a waterfall.
The intricate glazed ceramic construction ensures durability and serves as a striking artistic focal point for any meditation corner or puja space.
Comes complete with 10 backflow incense cones to allow you to experience the magic immediately after unboxing.
The lotus symbolism aligns perfectly with themes of spiritual awakening, purity, and the transcendence of material attachment.
A stunning gift for yoga practitioners, meditators, and anyone who appreciates the meditative art and visual poetry of incense.
